name: Office Desk with a Volcano Inkwell
description: A quiet office desk hides a tiny erupting volcano inside an inkwell, with smoke drifting over blank papers.
prompt: A modern office desk in a quiet room, a black inkwell with a tiny erupting volcano, glowing orange mist, blank papers, window with stormy night, contrast of corporate calm and wild nature, photorealistic surreal, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: What would be the least boring thing to hide inside your workplace?
